ValidationRule.description: For Freight account, only team leads and Sys Admin can change the ownership.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_Freight_Owner_Changes_Restriction__c,NOT(CONTAINS( $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.Freight_Team_Leads__c, $User.Email )), NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED( OwnerId ) , OR(ISPICKVAL ( Type , "Freight-Branch"),ISPICKVAL ( Type , "Freight-Country"),ISPICKVAL ( Type , "Freight-Head Office")), AND($Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - SND', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - QCC', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - Freight'), PRIORVALUE(OwnerId) <> OwnerId)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Freight Account Ownership change is restricted to System Admin and Team Leads.
